Name: Crop Extension - More Detailed Crop Seasons
Author: Platonymous
TagLine: Allows setting crop seasons by day
Description:
**In 1.1.0 You can now edit the seasons directly when using [GMCM](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098).**

Instead of just "spring fall" etc. You can set the planting season for a crop by day using this format:

[season]-[startday]-[endday]
multiple seasons are seperated by |

This needs to be added after the regular season string, which should include all the seasons used in the detailed version.
Full seasons don't need a start and end day.
Example:

``
`(This parsnip could be planted from the 15th of spring until the 3rd of fall)`

You need to use other mods, like ContentPatcher to edit the new season identifier into the data.
If the player loads a Content Pack with detailed seasons but does not have this mod installed, the crop planting will still function as normal, only that it will use the full seasons and ignore the days.
